notes: TALENT COVERAGE: Browser attempts were blocked by Cloudflare and no slider/JavaScript build data could be recovered. Every requested spec has levels 10–60; * means the point is not attributable, not a recommendation to leave it unspent. Do not present these sparse records as complete builds.

TALENT METHOD: PRIEST:shadow level 10 is the rendered static slider state. SHAMAN:elemental, enhancement and restoration contain only levels explicitly named in the Icy Veins Leveling Talent Build bullets; earliest-unlock tables were not converted into point orders. Discipline and Holy have no recoverable per-level picks.

TALENT SOURCE FRESHNESS: Discipline and Holy extracts are dated October 16 and October 15, 2026, respectively, and retain beta-era statements. Shaman leveling pages were updated November 3–4. The live slider still needs checking after the launch reshuffle; no Classic Era order was substituted.

TREE NAMES: Shadow Magic and Elemental Combat are the source calculator/database tree labels, rather than the shortened spec names Shadow and Elemental. Confirm them against GetTalentTabInfo on client build 1.60.1 before shipping.

TANK BUILD: A Forever tank-shaman leveling guide exists: The Dungeon Coach, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vG9CuJFtdb0. Its transcript section 36:40–40:08 names the recorded partial order. Unnamed on-screen clicks remain *. No separate Icy Veins tank-shaman leveling build was found; do not copy the DPS build into enhancement_tank.

ALTERNATIVE SOURCE: https://mobalytics.gg/wow-forever/classes/shaman-leveling-guide-nicktew supplies an explicit 51-point Enhancement leveling order, captured separately in priest_shaman.sources.json under alternativeTalentBuilds rather than substituted for the requested Icy Veins order. Its Water Shield timing differs from the Icy Veins prose.

TALENT-ONLY UNLOCK: Shadowform spell 15473 is a Shadow Magic talent, earliest level 40 with 31 points, not a trainer purchase or quest reward. It is intentionally not misclassified in spellMilestones because the requested kind enum allows only quest|trainer. Source: https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/shadow-priest-leveling and https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/spells/15473. The default guide invests in Wand Specialization first, so earliest possible is not necessarily the recommended acquisition level.

SPELL IDS: Use rank-one/player-cast IDs, not guide auto-links to the highest rank or triggered damage. Verified examples: Desperate Prayer 13908 (level 10, Dwarf only; confidence H), not 19243 (level 58); Stoneskin Totem 8071, Searing Totem 3599 and Healing Stream Totem 5394, not 10408/10438/10463. Spell evidence is in priest_shaman.sources.json.

PRIEST RACIALS: Human has Divine Grace 1277370 at 10 and Feedback 13896 at 20; Dwarf has Desperate Prayer 13908 and Chastise 1277331; Gnome has Confounding Flash 1277455 and Contingency Plan 1277462. Fear Ward 6346 and Devouring Plague 2944 are baseline level-20 trainer spells without race restrictions in the Forever database. Source: https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/priest-class-quests and the corresponding Forever spell pages.

NEW GNOME QUEST GIVERS: Level-4 Garments of the Light follows Branstock Khalder in Coldridge Valley to Maxan Anvol in Kharanos. Level-10 and level-20 racial quests end with High Priestess Mims in Ironforge. Source: https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/priest-class-quests.

SKYBORNE: Only Horde/Windshaper Skyborne can be Shamans; neither Skyborne faction can be Priests. Their Earth quest starts at 3, while Stoneskin Totem spell metadata says 4; this conflict is retained with confidence M. Fire starts at 10; mainland Water/Air use the Horde routes. The Skyborne race token follows the existing rules.json convention and still needs runtime confirmation. Sources: https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/shaman-class-quests and https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24302071/wow-forever-meet-the-new-skyborne.

AIR TOTEM CAVEAT: Call of Air rewards inventory item 5178, not a learned spell. The two quest milestones use Grounding Totem 8177 as a spell-access proxy only; it must be trained separately at 30. This does not directly prove quest completion. Quest sources: https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/quests/94789 and https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/quests/1531.

TOTEM QUEST LEVELS: Levels are minimum quest-start levels from the class guide, not recommended solo completion levels. Database quest-chain labels (for example the level-22 Dwarf Water steps) are quest levels, not proof of a level-22 minimum. Dwarf Water final quest 94505 labels its Healing Stream reward Cast on you while the spell page lists it as a reward; confirm the actual learned spell in-game.

SHAMAN TRAINER IDS: Fire Nova 408341 is the level-12 player-cast spell. Guide-linked 8349 is a triggered damage spell; Classic candidate 1535 returned 404 in the Forever database. Totemic Call 437009 is the database name at 22, although prose also calls the relocation ability Totemic Projection.

PROC SAFETY: procSpells is intentionally empty. Maelstrom Weapon 408498, Improved Stormstrike 1223031 and Searing Light 14909 are passive talents; Lightning Bolt, Stormstrike and Holy Nova are not inherently proc-only actions. No validated proc-only cast ID/window suitable for this add-on usability detector was found. Do not insert passive aura IDs or arbitrary windows.

RACE FILTERS: Scourge is the Undead raceFile token; NightElf is the Night Elf token. Shared-named Shaman quests are routed using milestone races, not raceOnlyQuests, because their identical names/rewards span all Shaman races. The Tempest's Weapons rewards are shared and are not race-locked.

POST-30 QUEST GAP: The class-quest guides explicitly lack verified later-level quest coverage. The Tempest's Weapons chain starts after Call of Air at 30 but is difficult until roughly 35–40 or with assistance; no unsupported later class-quest unlock was invented.
IMPORTANCE: The numeric importance scores are editorial prioritization, not sourced game mechanics. Confidence rates evidence for each milestone, not the numerical score.
